aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: When a gun-selling partner murders his friend's girlfriend and escapes to Turkey, the betrayed man sets out on a relentless pursuit of revenge.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: Operating an illegal arms dealing business in Australia, two close friends find their bond shattered when one commits an unforgivable act. After murdering his partner's girlfriend, the killer flees the country to seek refuge in Turkey. Consumed by grief and betrayal, the surviving partner embarks on an international hunt across continents to exact vengeance. Their violent clash probes the heavy toll of retribution against a backdrop of love and deception.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: In the criminal underworld of Australia, two long-time friends build a lucrative but dangerous business trading firearms. Their successful partnership disintegrates into tragedy when personal tensions escalate, culminating in one friend murdering the other's girlfriend. To escape the immediate fallout and legal consequences, the perpetrator flees overseas to Turkey, establishing a new hideout. Devastated by the loss of his love and furious at the ultimate betrayal, the surviving partner abandons the arms business to hunt down his former ally. Tracking the killer from Australia's criminal circles to the unfamiliar streets of Turkey, he navigates dangerous foreign territory to deliver justice. As the search intensifies, the line between retribution and self-destruction blurs for the grieving gunman. The confrontation ultimately forces both men to face the bloody consequences of their shared past. In the end, the journey reveals how deep-seated ambition and mistrust can irrevocably tear apart even the closest bonds.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: Set across Australia and Turkey, this intense action drama follows two business partners navigating the high-stakes world of illicit gun sales. Their enterprise unravels when a shocking act of violence and betrayal destroys their alliance, forcing one man onto a globe-trotting quest for vengeance while the other attempts to evade his past.
